gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Tektur draws every curve with a pipe-cleaner stroke and generous openings. Noto Sans Coptic sits beneath it as a sans-serif with a dominant middle zone, and the two make a strikingly distinct partnership of wire and mass.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Tektur keeps its letter parts at one visual mass, like wire bent into shape with oversized lowercase. And Noto Sans Cuneiform follows with an e that opens wide and a lowercase puffed up like glass beads, so text feels soft and bubbly.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Tektur strings its heading out in spaghetti-like strokes of constant width, with oversized lowercase and open curve endings, while Noto Sans Deseret sits beneath it. Their strongest quality is that wiry, uniform line against a wide, squat plain sans.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Expressive thread-of-ink letters in Tektur carry no swelling or tapering anywhere, set against Noto Sans Devanagari with its compact skyline and open-curved g. Wire up top, tight and quiet below.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Distinctive rounded-wire lettering in Tektur leads with its open curve endings, while Noto Sans Duployan follows with a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters. One is for showing off, the other for settling in.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan reads large and open, with terminals that never pinch. Tektur adds headings that look sketched by a pencil pressing evenly, so the page gets personality above and steady, roomy text below.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Distinctive in a fixed-nib way, Tektur makes letters that look drawn with one unchanging pen width. And Noto Sans Elymaic, a sans-serif with open apertures, leaves the heading to earn its keep in big, short lines.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Expressive marker plainness runs through every Tektur character. Noto Sans Ethiopic follows with sturdy tall lowercase and c terminals hanging far from the bowl, so a longer read feels upright and firm beneath a playful heading.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Tektur looks drawn with a single pen tip. Beside it, Noto Sans Georgian brings open curves and short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies, and the two feel like a quirky sketch next to a tidy typeset line.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Wiry yet chunky-bright, Tektur gives its o sides and top the same thickness. But Noto Sans Gothic's big, bead-like counters and parenthesis-round forms give it a rounder voice, and that clash is the pair's strongest quality.
